title: After the Public Exposure
description:
Two months since Jaehyuk's situation became public.
Being directly involved — left complicated feelings.
Today word came that things had been resolved.

choices.result_text:
Done.
Exposing it hadn't been easy — but it was the right direction.
The right thing and the easy thing — aren't always the same.

Still complicated.
But it was done.
Complicated feelings remaining doesn't mean the choice was wrong.

title: After Winning the Standoff
description:
Two months since you stood up to Jaehyuk and won.
Today you looked back on that time.
Winning wasn't just good.

choices.result_text:
It was right.
Better if it hadn't come to a fight — but it had to, and you won.
That sequence is what put you here.

choices.text: Think about why you were able to win
choices.result_text:
Preparation is what won it.
Fighting on emotion alone — the outcome would have been different.
Standing firm, but cold — that was how.

title: After Testifying
description:
Two months since you testified in the Jaehyuk matter.
It wasn't an easy decision.
Today the result came in.

choices.result_text:
It was resolved.
Testifying had made the outcome.
If you hadn't spoken — nothing would have changed.
There are times when speaking up is the only right move — even when uncomfortable.

title: After the Warm Moment
description:
Two months since the first moment something genuine passed between you and your father.
That feeling had stayed.
Today an unexpected text from him.
'Minjun. Have you eaten.'

choices.result_text:
He said 'I did too.'
A short text.
But it was a continuation of that day.
The warm moment had called the next message.

You sent an emoji.
He didn't know how to reply with one so he sent just 'ok'.
Awkward — but connected.

title: The Deepened Reconciliation
description:
Three months since the reconciliation with your father had deepened further.
Today, for the first time, he said 'I miss you.'

choices.result_text:
'Me too. I'll come this weekend,' you said.
He just said 'Okay.'
Inside that 'Okay' — a lot of old things were held.

You said 'Me too.'
Short — but it was the first time you'd said that to him.
Reconciliation had lowered the walls of words.

title: The Deepened Bond with Your Parents
description:
Three months since the relationship with your parents deepened.
Today your mother called.
She talked for a long time.

choices.text: Happily stay on the phone for a long time
choices.result_text:
You talked for an hour.
Her talking longer — was evidence the relationship had changed.
Parents need someone to talk to as well.

choices.text: Wrap it up and say you'll call again soon
choices.result_text:
'I'll call again soon,' you said.
She asked 'Are you busy?'
'No, just,' you said.
That exchange felt awkward.

title: After Paying Off Your Parents' Debt
description:
Two months since you paid off your parents' debt for them.
Today your mother called.

choices.result_text:
She said 'Thank you.'
It had taken a long time to hear those words.
What was repaid wasn't the debt — it was the relationship.

'It's the natural thing,' you said.
She said 'It's not.'
For parents — what their child does for them isn't ever just natural.

title: Regretting the Sangchul Deal
description:
Two months since you started regretting not taking Sangchul's offer.
Today you ran into Sangchul.

choices.text: Say honestly that you regretted it
choices.result_text:
'I regret not going in on that,' you said.
Sangchul replied 'Still — you had your reasons.'
Saying the regret out loud — brought them closer.

You let it go.
So did Sangchul.
Regret is something you carry.
Leaving it unspoken — made it heavier later.

title: A Deeper Trust with Sangchul
description:
Three months since trust with Sangchul had gone a level deeper.
Today Sangchul opened up about something personal.

choices.result_text:
You listened.
Sangchul said 'I only tell you this.'
The deep trust — had made this conversation possible.
A business relationship had become a real one.

You thought it through together.
Sangchul said 'Thanks.'
Carrying someone's troubles with them — that's what a real relationship is.

title: After Being Hired Through the Chain
description:
Two months since you got the job through the franchise owner's introduction.
Today you reached out to thank the person who made it happen.

choices.text: Let them know you've settled in well
choices.result_text:
'Thanks to you, things are going well,' you said.
They replied 'Glad to hear it.'
When you get an introduction — letting them know how it went is the right thing to do.

choices.text: Say it's still tough but you're learning
choices.result_text:
'Still learning,' you said.
They said 'That's the right attitude.'
Being honest — built more trust with the person who'd referred you.

title: Credit Recovery in Progress
description:
Three months since you started the credit recovery.
Keeping up with the payments.
Today you checked your credit score.

choices.result_text:
It had gone up.
A little.
But the direction had changed.
Credit takes a long time to build and a moment to collapse.
It was on the way up.

choices.text: Still not enough — look for a faster way
choices.result_text:
You looked for shortcuts.
Conclusion: there was none other than consistent payments.
Slow — but that was the right way.

title: When the Plan Becomes Reality
description:
Half a year since you made the loan repayment plan.
Today — by the plan's timeline — half should be paid off.

choices.result_text:
Half was gone.
The plan made six months ago — had become this number.
When a plan produces results — you start believing the next one too.

Behind.
But the direction was right.
Not reaching the plan isn't failure.
Not having a direction is.

title: When the Lie Was Forgiven
description:
Two months since you lied — and were forgiven.
Today you saw that person again.

choices.text: Resolve to never lie to them again
choices.result_text:
You talked naturally.
Forgiveness didn't reset the relationship.
But you knew — there wouldn't be a second time.
Knowing that shaped what came next.

You acted naturally.
So did they.
Someone who forgives — can still be natural afterward.
That's what real forgiveness looks like.

title: After Coming Fully Clean
description:
A month since you laid everything out honestly.
The time since — had been different.

choices.result_text:
Lighter.
Secrets have weight.
The lightness after coming clean — told you it should have happened sooner.

Still anxious.
Unclear what would come of it.
But sitting with the uncertainty — was better than hiding.
At least it was honest.
